featured.title: SigProfilerCurator
featured.desc: An agentic literature-curation pipeline that builds a living, evidence-graded reference of all 101 COSMICv3.6 SBS mutational signatures. LLM agents search, read, cross-check and draft, and a human curator signs off on the result.
details: LLM agents turn the published literature into short, cited claims for each signature.
Every claim is graded by strength of evidence and checked against its sources.
Agent output is benchmarked against expert review, and a human curator makes the final call.
Results are shared as an interactive reference that both people and chat assistants can query.
